Account or sync help

Tell us which page you were using, what you expected and what happened. Include your device and browser if relevant. For a sync issue, the short error and pending save ID shown in the sidebar can help. Keep your pending backup before restoring.

Ideas for the app

Signed-in users can use the suggestions page to prepare a feature request or bug report. You can also contact support directly. Please avoid including private portfolio records unless they are necessary and you are comfortable sharing them.

Privacy and account requests

For access, correction or deletion requests, contact support from the email linked to your account. We may ask for enough information to verify ownership. Never send a password, login code, API key or complete financial statement.
